result.stdout:
gscript 2.0.0-alpha.6 - self-healing, cross-platform git-push + dev-ops ceremony USAGE: gscript push [options] gscript task (the comms task-bus) OPTIONS: --files comma-separated paths to stage (explicit; never `git add .`) --message, -m commit message --no-deploy append [skip ci]; skip CI watch + probes --no-watch push but don't watch CI --dry-run run gates + divergence check, then stop (no commit/push) --no-sync disable the pre-push auto-fast-forward when origin advanced disjointly --require-clean fail if files outside --files are modified/untracked (runner-tree hygiene) --max-shrink-pct N relax file-size + markdown shrink gates to N% for this push --allow-shrink

exempt one path from the shrink gates (repeatable) --config gscript.json (default: ./gscript.json if present) --repo-owner override repo owner --repo-name override repo name --workflow CI workflow filename (default: deploy.yml) --working-dir repo root (default: current directory) --localmd localmd/PAT path (default: %USERPROFILE%\private\local.md; or gscript.json localmdPath/patFile) --log append a markdown push-log entry per successful push (or gscript.json logFile) -h, --help this help -v, --version version Repo-level config (owner, gates, probes, visibility) lives in gscript.json; per-sprint data (files, message) is given on the CLI or in gscript.json.
